name: Heaven’s Call
body:
School illusion (glamer) [good]; Level bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, mesmerist 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (ground sunstone worth at least 5 gp)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect 50-ft.-radius emanation
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You overlay a realistic illusion of a heavenly realm upon an area. Structures, equipment, and creatures within the area are not hidden, though environmental features take on an angelic appearance. Evil-aligned creatures within the area must make a Will save or become shaken and also take a –2 penalty on saves versus fear effects; the fear and penalty persists as long as the creature remains in the area. Good-aligned creatures gain a +4 bonus on Will saves against fear effects while within the area.
